title: Circle headers read cleanly on a phone: no badges over the title, art in its own band, tidy buttons

source.ref: Owner screenshot of Mindless Carlsbad at phone width, 2026-11-20: "We need to make these circle headers actually look good in mobile."

detail:
At phone width the Circle cover laid the status badge and the Part of <Space> pill absolutely over the title, set the name, facts and buttons in white over the cover art (a Space's logo header bled through the text), and wrapped QR, Create, Edit and Manage into two uneven rows of oversized glass pills.

DONE 2026-11-20: the badge and the pill now sit in their own row in flow (.fqc-cover-top), so they can never cover the title at any width; the art is its own layer (.fqc-cover-art). Under 520px of column (a container query on .fqc, so phones and narrow tablets, never the 1280+ desktop column) the art becomes a 2:1 band carrying the badges, and the name, facts and buttons sit below it on the kit's glass panel in the kit's ink. The primary action (Create or Join) spans the row and QR, Edit and Manage share the next at 44px; a visitor gets Join beside QR. Tabs are 40px with no stretching. Every Circle uses the same shell, so this covers all of them. Rendered at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 with a logo cover, a photo cover and no cover: the desktop cover keeps its overlay look.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
